summary: SunPower Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) with the Rodgers Massey Revocable Living Trust, an affiliate of CEO Thurman J. Rodgers, for a $2,000,000 investment. The SAFE converts automatically into equity at the next financing round's price per share with no discount, subject to Nasdaq listing rules. The offering relies on Section 4(a)(2) exemption. This is a routine funding agreement, not a special-situation event. No extraordinary changes, strategic reviews, or transaction catalysts are present; it merely represents a related-party capital infusion with standard future-equity conversion mechanics.
